heading: About
big: I’m from Boise, Idaho, where the public schools helped make me who I am. My dad immigrated from Nepal; my mom grew up in a small Idaho town.
body:
At UNC I studied public policy and sociology as a Morehead-Cain Scholar and graduated in 2026 with highest distinction and highest honors in public policy. I want a career designing policy that speeds the energy transition in America’s K–12 schools.

I like hard problems with real stakeholders, and I seek out people who disagree with me.

details.label: Education
details.text: UNC–Chapel Hill. B.A. with highest distinction (2026): Public Policy with highest honors, Sociology, and a minor in Mathematics. M.P.P. expected 2027.

details.label: Abroad
details.text: Lived in Santiago, Chile, for a semester of study abroad (2025) and in Mexico City for a summer of policy research (2026). Advanced working Spanish.

details.label: Skills
details.text: R, Stata, Tableau, Java and MAXQDA. Human-centered design. Semi-structured interviews and qualitative analysis.

details.label: Off the clock
details.text: Prancing around in the mountains, running long distances, painting, and dancing salsa (badly).
